mapper.insert: INSERT INTO environment_sandboxes ( uuid, external_id, organization_uuid, workspace_uuid, environment_uuid, environment_external_id, work_uuid, work_external_id, provider, template, provider_sandbox_id, state, metadata, last_error, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{params.UUID}, #{params.ExternalID}, #{params.OrganizationUUID}, #{params.WorkspaceUUID}, #{params.EnvironmentUUID}, #{params.EnvironmentExternalID}, #{params.WorkUUID}, #{params.WorkExternalID}, #{params.Provider}, #{params.Template}, #{params.ProviderSandboxID}, #{params.State}, CAST(#{params.Metadata,sensitive=true} AS jsonb), #{params.LastError,sensitive=true}, #{params.CreatedAt}, #{params.CreatedAt} ) RETURNING
mapper.select: SELECT s.uuid FROM sessions s JOIN environment_work work ON work.session_uuid = s.uuid AND work.organization_uuid = s.organization_uuid AND work.workspace_uuid = s.workspace_uuid JOIN environment_sandboxes sandbox ON sandbox.work_uuid = work.uuid AND sandbox.organization_uuid = work.organization_uuid AND sandbox.workspace_uuid = work.workspace_uuid WHERE sandbox.workspace_uuid = #{workspaceUUID} AND sandbox.external_id = #{sandboxExternalID} FOR UPDATE OF s
mapper.update: WITH target AS ( SELECT sandbox.uuid, COALESCE(s.archived_at IS NOT NULL AND env.config->>'type' = 'cloud', false) AS archived FROM environment_sandboxes sandbox LEFT JOIN environment_work work ON work.uuid = sandbox.work_uuid AND work.organization_uuid = sandbox.organization_uuid AND work.workspace_uuid = sandbox.workspace_uuid LEFT JOIN sessions s ON s.uuid = work.session_uuid AND s.organization_uuid = work.organization_uuid AND s.workspace_uuid = work.workspace_uuid LEFT JOIN environments env ON env.uuid = s.environment_uuid AND env.organization_uuid = s.organization_uuid AND env.workspace_uuid = s.workspace_uuid WHERE sandbox.workspace_uuid = #{params.WorkspaceUUID} AND sandbox.external_id = #{params.ExternalID} ) UPDATE environment_sandboxes sandbox SET state = CASE WHEN target.archived OR sandbox.stop_reason = 'session_archived' THEN 'stopping' ELSE #{params.State} END, stop_reason = CASE WHEN target.archived OR sandbox.stop_reason = 'session_archived' THEN 'session_archived' ELSE sandbox.stop_reason END, provider_sandbox_id = COALESCE(#{params.ProviderSandboxID}, sandbox.provider_sandbox_id), last_error = #{params.LastError,sensitive=true}, stopped_at = CASE WHEN target.archived OR sandbox.stop_reason = 'session_archived' THEN sandbox.stopped_at ELSE COALESCE(#{params.StoppedAt}, sandbox.stopped_at) END, updated_at = NOW() FROM target WHERE sandbox.uuid = target.uuid AND (sandbox.state <> 'stopped' OR sandbox.stop_reason IS DISTINCT FROM 'session_archived')

FROM environment_sandboxes WHERE uuid = ( SELECT sandbox.uuid FROM code_sessions code_session JOIN environment_work work ON work.organization_uuid = code_session.organization_uuid AND work.workspace_uuid = code_session.workspace_uuid AND work.environment_uuid = code_session.environment_uuid AND work.environment_external_id = code_session.environment_external_id AND work.session_uuid = code_session.session_uuid AND work.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN environment_sandboxes sandbox ON sandbox.organization_uuid = code_session.organization_uuid AND sandbox.workspace_uuid = code_session.workspace_uuid AND sandbox.environment_uuid = code_session.environment_uuid AND sandbox.work_uuid = work.uuid AND sandbox.provider_sandbox_id IS NOT NULL AND sandbox.state = 'running' WHERE code_session.external_id = #{codeSessionExternalID} AND code_session.status = 'active' AND code_session.worker_status IN
#{workerStatus}
AND code_session.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY sandbox.created_at DESC, sandbox.uuid DESC LIMIT 1 )
